title: Facilitation, Objections & Pitfalls
body: Workshop facilitation craft, handling common objections to Blueprint and to value claims, and avoiding the anti-patterns that stall deals
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Apply facilitation techniques that keep sessions consultative and on time.
Handle objections such as 'just give us a pilot' and 'these are just benchmarks'.
Recognize and correct common Blueprint anti-patterns.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-105. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
